user.title: Family Tree
user.description: Give this family tree a name. You can change it later.

gazetteer.title: Place search countries
gazetteer.description: Select countries to download for offline place lookup (GeoNames). You need this for searching birth/death/marriage places. You can change this later under Configure.

data_description.gazetteer_countries: Pick from the list or type ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes (e.g. NL, BE, DE). Leave empty to skip; place search stays manual until you add countries.

shortcuts.title: Family shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Optional surname shortcuts shown in the Family Tree panel (e.g. your main family names). Leave empty if unsure — you can add them later under Configure.

data_description.family_shortcuts: Type a surname and press Enter (e.g. Molenschot, van Iersel). Matching ignores Dutch prefixes for sorting.

init.title: Family Tree options
init.description: Offline place-search countries and surname shortcuts for this tree.

data_description.gazetteer_countries: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes to download from GeoNames (e.g. NL, BE).
data_description.family_shortcuts: Surnames shown as quick links in the panel (e.g. van Iersel).
